status: Original candidate art. Technically inspected; runtime integration and playback are parent-owned.
source_coordinates: Original PNG pixels. Rectangles are [x,y,width,height], half-open. Ground anchors are relative to each rectangle. Do not split this atlas with a uniform 4x2 grid.
scale_note: One CONSTANT scale per role for all four rise frames. Approximates existing standing demon/caster height at old renderer scale 0.25. Do not normalize each pose by its bbox height.

alpha_qa.edge_case: Generator produced sparse alpha=1 haze outside main silhouettes; preserved exactly. No background checkerboard. Most interior alpha is 252 or 253. This is real RGBA transparency, not binary-alpha/palette-certified pixel art.

visual_qa.distinct_pose_progression: Each role has visibly independent prone, elbows, kneeling and upright silhouette; not transformed reuse.
visual_qa.identity: Red demon retains two ivory horns, red skin, charcoal armor, brown waistcloth and one curved cleaver. Caster retains two red horns, violet hood/cape, dark face and two ember eyes.
visual_qa.anatomy: No extra arms or legs observed. Prone figures use natural limb occlusion. Caster hands are connected in elbows/kneeling/upright poses. Demon kneeling free palm is grounded.
visual_qa.weapon_limitation: Demon elbow pose leaves the cleaver resting beside the right hand instead of visibly gripped. Do not claim continuous weapon-hand contact is certified. The kneeling and upright poses have a single gripped cleaver.
visual_qa.style_limitation: Matched existing cartoon pixel-like source art. Native64 grid, strict palette and binary alpha are not certified.
visual_qa.runtime_limitation: Actual engine playback, hit timing and foot/root continuity have not been tested by this art-only worker.

frames.anchor_quality: Visual root/ground estimate; validate actual engine playback. Never use cleaver extent as ground point.
